product_summary: Windsor Agro (Gurugram, Haryana; second office Inder Puri, New Delhi) positions itself as a manufacturer and supplier of agricultural machinery and spare parts, in the trade since 1996 per its own About page. Real catalogue from windsoragro.com: (1) disc blades - plain, notched, flat centre, raised flat back, conical, dimpled, fluted, dome; (2) combine harvester parts - fingers, blades, raspbar, grain lifter, cutter bar; (3) agricultural implements - rotary tiller, tiller cultivator, disc harrow, disc plough, mould board plough, ridger/furrower, land leveller, sub soiler, post hole digger, mower, rotary slasher, crop planting harvester, potato harvester; (4) three-point linkage parts - balls, bushes, clevis pins, draw bar, hair pins, headless pins, hitch pins, implement pins, levelling box assembly, lift arm, lower links, lynch pins, PTO parts, ratchet jack, side links, stabilizer kits, T bolts, top links, turn buckles, weld-on ball ends, wire lock pins; (5) tractor parts for Fiat, UTB, Ursus, Ford, MTZ, MF; truck parts for Mercedes, Volvo, DAF, Scania; trailer parts; car parts for Mercedes, Daewoo, Hyundai, Suzuki, Peugeot; (6) featured items - connecting rod, oil seal, bearing, torque rod bushing, cross holder, drain plug. Site states products are 'highly demanded in european markets' and claims hundreds of clients worldwide.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader - site consistently claims own manufacturing ('industry-leading manufacturer', 'our factories', QA facility) but the catalogue is a very broad multi-brand spare-parts range (Fiat/UTB/Ursus/Ford/MTZ/MF tractors, Mercedes/Volvo/DAF/Scania trucks, Daewoo/Hyundai/Suzuki/Peugeot cars) which is typical of an assembler/trader of aftermarket parts rather than a single-line producer. No customs line or shipment record was checked in this task, so the export claim is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'.
comment: HS mapping: declared 843390 is CORRECT but covers only a fraction of the range - it fits the combine/potato harvester parts. Declared 870899 is CORRECT for the tractor/truck/car/trailer parts line (though many of those items are fasteners and linkage hardware that belong in 7318 rather than 8708). Declared 847710 (injection-moulding machines) is WRONG: nothing on the site is a plastics injection-moulding machine; the site mentions no moulding equipment at all. The bulk of the catalogue - disc blades, harrows, ploughs, cultivators, tillers, subsoilers, levellers, slashers, mowers, planters - is missing from the declaration and belongs in 8432 (843210/843221/843229/843280/843231) and 843353 for the potato harvester. Fastener/linkage hardware (lynch pins, clevis pins, hitch pins, top links, turn buckles, ball ends, bushes) belongs in 7318/732690 and PTO shafts in 8483. Industry classification 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy and mining) is a MISCLASSIFICATION: the company is agricultural machinery and agri/truck/auto spare parts - the correct industry is agricultural machinery / auto components. No metallurgical or mining product appears anywhere on the site. Per project rule 3 the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: company is kept, codes corrected to the actual range, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. All product facts above come from windsoragro.com (home, about-us, sitemap pages); no customs line, B/L or GST record was examined here, so actual shipments remain 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Legal name 'WINDSOR EXPORTS' could not be corroborated - the site uses only the brand 'Windsor Agro' and gives no legal entity name, CIN or PAN; that field is unverified (null).
